show.description:
One reckless night binds a ruthless CEO to a woman fate refuses to let him forget.
When she walks into his office as an employee. But destiny twists cruelly as a new woman’s arrival fuels lies, jealousy, and half-heard truths. Broken trust leads to painful separation, leaving love buried under pride and regret. What comes next is a storm of revelations, longing, and a final battle between past mistakes and true love?
